title: Sum of subarray minimums
statement:
Return the sum of min(b) over every contiguous subarray b of a, modulo 10⁹ + 7.

Constraints: up to 3 × 10⁴ elements, values up to 3 × 10⁴.
hints: Change the question: for each element, in how many subarrays is it the minimum?
That's (distance to previous smaller) × (distance to next smaller-or-equal). Break ties on one side only.

solution.explanation: Contribution technique: a[i] is the minimum of exactly left[i] × right[i] subarrays, where left[i] is the distance to the previous strictly smaller element and right[i] the distance to the next smaller-or-equal one (asymmetric tie-breaking counts each subarray once). Two monotonic-stack passes compute them.
